description: The audit session's whole verdict: every finding, or none.

findings.description: One finding per distinct thing a stranger would learn; empty when none.

items.description:
One finding from the judgment scanner's audit session.

``start``/``end`` are absent when the finding localizes to no span —
"this paragraph implies an unreleased capability" has nothing to
excise, and the gate blocks rather than redacting such a finding.

end.description: Character offset just past the leaking span, on the same terms.
end.title: End

rationale.description: One sentence saying what a stranger would learn, and why it matters.
rationale.title: Rationale

start.description: Character offset where the leaking span starts, counted from the start of the payload. Absent when the leak is carried by a passage rather than a substring.
start.title: Start
